objectives.title: Run a full HDSP simulation chain
Diagnose ASM or design-model to k-Wave domain gap
Connect acoustic pressure to curing result
Prepare for cavitation-aware HDSP curing model

gaps.task_relation: Metrics exist in script output, but Codex needs stable JSON snapshots to compare runs.
gaps.current_evidence: HDSPdebug.m prints PCC/SSIM/NMSE/IoU/Dice/over/under values, but no stable run manifest is detected.
gaps.target_state: Every run writes one JSON result with parameters, metric values, artifact paths, git revision, and timestamp.
gaps.next_action: Add a non-invasive MATLAB result export block after reporting, guarded by a flag so the main logic remains unchanged.

gaps.task_relation: The task goal depends on reducing forward-design to k-Wave domain mismatch.
gaps.current_evidence: Existing handoff identifies ASM/ideal phase to 3D discrete k-Wave mismatch as the main problem.
gaps.target_state: Use exported exit-plane samples to fit or validate an effective transmission model for discrete thickness voxels.
gaps.next_action: Use current exit-plane diagnostics and surrogate data to map thickness, local gradient, and edge distance to exit amplitude/phase correction.

gaps.task_relation: HDSP/DSP literature points to cavitation-driven sonochemistry, while current implementation is thermal-dose dominant.
gaps.current_evidence: cavitation_limit is detected as a static pressure cap before heat-source and Arrhenius curing calculations.
gaps.target_state: Introduce a threshold-triggered cavitation activation field with saturation/penalty, fused with the existing thermal dose.
gaps.next_action: Prototype a sidecar cavitation score from p_3d_scaled, then compare pure thermal versus thermal+cavitation metrics.

gaps.task_relation: Task materials mention multiple target metrics but no single optimization decision rule.
gaps.current_evidence: PCC/SSIM/NMSE/EE/IoU/Dice/Over-cure/Under-cure are present, but tradeoff priority is not machine-readable.
gaps.target_state: Define a weighted score or Pareto rule for model selection by experiment type.
gaps.next_action: Create a score profile that prioritizes IoU/Dice and penalizes over-cure for curing prediction, while keeping ASM/k-Wave mismatch metrics for diagnosis.
